explanation: The property represents that when the sensor limit condition is exceeded ('limits'), and it's not in a standby mode ('!standby'), while the system support is enabled without failures ('supported & !apfail'), then the autopilot will initiate a pullup maneuver ('pullup'). Thus, we used 'while bool_exp1' to show that this condition holds over time. The final decision satisfies pulling up when all these conditions are met.
decision1_substring: when the pilot is not in control (not standby) and the system is supported without failures (not apfail)
decision3_substring: Exceeding sensor limits shall latch an autopilot pullup
output_structured_natural_language: while !standby & supported & !apfail, immediately satisfy limits -> pullup
